description: The bar chart illustrates the number of tokens distributed across various text categories. The horizontal axis, labeled "Categories", displays the categories in a non-sorted order with labels rotated diagonally. From left to right, the categories are Administrative, Religion, Non-fiction, Fiction, Law, an obscured label covered by a grey rectangle, Science, and Blogs. The vertical axis, labeled "Tokens (K)", represents the token count in thousands using a linear scale. Its value range extends from 0 to 10000, with numeric tick marks spaced at regular intervals of 2000. The chart features eight vertical, light blue bars, each corresponding to a category on the horizontal axis. Every bar is visually emphasized with its exact numerical value annotated in dark blue text directly above it. The tallest bar corresponds to the category with the obscured label, reaching a maximum value of 10584. The shortest bar represents the Blogs category, with a value of 32. The remaining bars have the following annotated values: Administrative at 6472, Religion at 652, Non-fiction at 1889, Fiction at 387, Law at 354, and Science at 1626. The bars are not sorted in any specific alphabetical or numerical order.
